Here's our return and refund policy:
Cancellations before shipping:
You can cancel an order for a full refund within three days of purchase, provided it hasn't shipped. Once an order has shipped, cancellation is no longer possible.
After delivery:
Once an order has been safely and successfully delivered, we do not accept returns due to change of heart or taste. Due to state regulations, we cannot accept the return of alcohol purchased by a customer in error.
EU customers only:
Orders placed via the EU Flaviar website (https://eu.flaviar.com/) can be returned within 14 days from the delivery date according to EU regulations. You are responsible for the costs of postage and packaging.
Issues with your order:
If you experience a problem with your order (damage, wrong item, etc.), contact us within 7 days of the delivery date with your order number, explanation of the issue, and a photo showing the problem.
Non-returnable items:
Personalized items (e.g., engraved), all items from presales, special releases, and items of seasonal relevance are non-returnable and non-refundable.
Non-delivery refunds:
